title: 第1819章 道尊之下死第1818章 叶无涯出手
slug: 穿书女频大婚当日被女主杀死
content_zh:
疾！
叶无涯化作一道残芒，一个箭步杀向道明光，他并未拔剑，而是右手握拳，一拳轰向道明光胸口。
“糟了......”
道明光还未稳住身躯，见叶无涯挥拳杀来，他已然来不及避让。
砰！
叶无涯的拳头霸道地轰击在道明光的胸口上，一阵爆裂声响起。
道明光的胸口被拳头贯穿，碎骨、内脏、血肉从背部喷涌而出，身躯犹如炮弹一般倒飞三百米，血水飞洒，浸染天地。
“啊......”
道明光面容扭曲，发出一道凄厉的惨叫声。
叶无涯眼神凶戾，脚踏天虚，瞬间来到道明光身前，抬起脚，一记鞭腿轰杀而出。
这位道尊一境的战力，比他想象中的弱了不少，这一战他无须拔剑，便可镇杀对方。
所谓仙道之力可凌驾万道，但只要你战力足够强大的时候，即使是面对仙道之力，亦可强势镇压。
“......”
道明光见叶无涯宛若一尊太古蛮龙杀来，他依旧难以避让，只能忍着疼痛，挥动紫色道剑挡在身前。
轰隆！
叶无涯一脚轰击在道明光的道剑上。
这柄紫色道剑被他一脚轰爆，道明光握剑的手臂也被震成血雾，身躯再度倒飞几百米，口鼻喷血，毫无抵抗之力。
“死！”
叶无涯再度杀到道明光上方，他伸出手，掌中浮现一轮大印，便要一巴掌拍死道明光。
“出手！”

剩下的十一人见状，他们脸色一沉，也管不得太多，立刻杀向叶无涯。
轰隆！
可惜他们的速度还是慢了半拍，叶无涯一巴掌轰下，道明光的脑袋被拍在肚子里，身躯顿时爆裂，化作漫天血雾，神魂俱灭，仙道之力溃散。
嗡嗡！
这些溃散的仙道之力正在与道明光的血雾融合，欲要重塑道明光的身躯。
重塑的身躯，即使神魂不是道明光的，也会在仙道之力的加持下，再度诞生出神祇，只是这尊神祇，会有仙道意识，属于仙族一员。
“哼！”
叶无涯冷哼一声，大手伸出，将这团血雾和仙道之力封锁，直接进行镇压。
与此同时，那十一人已然杀来。
“道尊之下，死！”
叶无涯扫了十一人一眼，他的眼中闪过一道寒芒，一股寂灭剑意自他身上爆发。
轰隆！
十一人之中，除了那位道尊二境，其余的道尊之下，顷刻间被寂灭剑意碾成齑粉，死得不能再死。
“小畜生，去死吧。”
那位道尊二境怒吼一声，一记无敌拳印轰杀向叶无涯。
叶无涯没有避让，他立刻挥动青萍剑鞘挡在身前。
轰！
那位道尊二境的拳印轰击在青萍剑鞘上，强大的力量顿时将叶无涯震退百米。
“混元锏！”
那位道尊二境伸出手，祭出一柄十八节金色宝锏，他横跨百米，杀到叶无涯身前，一锏劈出，宝锏闪烁着万道金光，凶威滔天，将空间轰成齑粉。

叶无涯再度挥动剑鞘抵挡。
轰隆！
宝锏轰击在剑鞘上，叶无涯手臂开裂，身躯被震飞三百米，嘴角溢出一抹鲜血。
“区区道祖九境巅峰，以为有点越级的战力，便可无法无天，妄图挑衅道尊？简直不知死活！”
那位道尊二境见叶无涯吐血，他冷然一笑，再度杀向叶无涯，一锏劈出。
content_en:
disease!
Ye Wuya turned into a residual light and struck at Dao Mingguang with one arrow. He did not draw his sword, but made a fist with his right hand and punched Dao Mingguang's chest.
"Oops..."
Before Dao Mingguang could stabilize his body, he saw Ye Wuya swinging his fist to kill him, and he had no time to avoid it.
Bang!
Ye Wuya's fist struck Dao Mingguang's chest domineeringly, and a burst of explosions sounded.
Dao Mingguang's chest was penetrated by a fist, and broken bones, internal organs, and flesh and blood spurted out from his back. His body flew backwards for three hundred meters like a cannonball, blood flying and soaking the world.
"Ah..."
Dao Mingguang's face was distorted and he let out a shrill scream.
Ye Wuya's eyes were fierce, his feet were on the sky, and he came to Dao Mingguang in an instant, raised his feet, and blasted out with a whip kick.
The fighting power of this Taoist First Realm was much weaker than he thought. In this battle, he could kill the opponent without drawing his sword.
The so-called power of immortality can surpass all the powers, but as long as your combat power is strong enough, you can suppress it even if you face the power of immortality.
"..."
Dao Mingguang saw Ye Wuya coming towards him like an ancient savage dragon, but he still couldn't avoid it. He could only endure the pain and wave the purple Dao sword in front of him.
Boom!
Ye Wuya kicked Dao Mingguang's Dao sword.
The purple Dao sword was exploded by his kick, and Dao Mingguang's arm holding the sword was also shaken into blood mist. His body flew backwards for several hundred meters again, blood spurted from his mouth and nose, and he was unable to resist.
"Death!"
Ye Wuya reached above Dao Mingguang again. He stretched out his hand, a big seal appeared in his palm, and was about to slap Dao Mingguang to death.
"Take action!"
When the remaining eleven people saw this, their faces darkened, and they couldn't care less and immediately attacked Ye Wuya.
Boom!
Unfortunately, their speed was still half a beat slower. Ye Wuya slapped down Dao Mingguang's head and was slapped in his stomach. His body suddenly exploded and turned into a blood mist that filled the sky. His soul was wiped out and his immortal power collapsed.
Buzz!
These collapsed immortal powers are merging with Dao Mingguang's blood mist, trying to reshape Dao Mingguang's body.
The reshaped body, even if the soul is not Dao Mingguang, will be born again with the blessing of the power of immortality, but this god will have the consciousness of immortality and belong to the immortal clan.
"Hmph!"
Ye Wuya snorted coldly, stretched out his big hand, blocked the blood mist and the power of immortality, and directly suppressed it.
At the same time, the eleven people had already come to kill them.
"Below the Taoist Lord, die!"
Ye Wuya glanced at the eleven people, a cold light flashed in his eyes, and a sword of annihilation erupted from him.
Boom!
Among the eleven people, except for the Taoist Master who was in the second realm, the rest of the Taoist Masters were instantly crushed into powder by the Nirvana Sword Intent, and they were too dead to die.
"You little beast, go to hell."
The Taoist Second Realm roared angrily and struck Ye Wuya with an invincible fist seal.
Ye Wuya did not give way, he immediately waved his Qingping sword scabbard in front of him.
boom!
The fist seal of the second-level Taoist struck Qingping's sword scabbard, and the powerful force immediately knocked Ye Wuya back a hundred meters.
"Hunyuan Mace!"
The Taoist Master of the Second Realm stretched out his hand and held out an eighteen-section golden mace. He crossed a hundred meters and reached in front of Ye Wuya. He slashed out with his mace. The mace flashed with thousands of golden lights and was so fierce that it blasted the space into powder.
Ye Wuya waved his scabbard again to resist.
Boom!
The mace struck the scabbard, causing Ye Wuya's arm to crack, his body to be blown three hundred meters away, and a trace of blood spilled from the corner of his mouth.
"You are just at the peak of the ninth realm of Taozu. You think that with a little bit of superior combat power, you can be lawless and try to provoke Taoist? You simply don't know how to live or die!"
Seeing Ye Wuya vomiting blood, the Taoist Master in the Second Realm smiled coldly and attacked Ye Wuya again, slashing out with his mace.
